For someone who's never played Touhou or much bullet hells, this is a nice Hololive themed introduction to the genre. Pretty fun time-sink, lots of references, music's absolutely banger, and there's also accessibility settings if you feel like having an easier time. Overall, a very solid game.

Play the demo, and see if you want more of that or not. In fact, feel free to grind the demo as progress carries over. This version has many more items to create builds with, and the boss attack patterns seem well thought out (I'd like to point out Botan's sniper duel phase and Luna's ability to summon an army). The game also provides you with a long term goal to keep you engaged, that being the insanely difficult boss fight teased in the trailer (I've unlocked and tried it, and it may take me a year of 'getting good' to beat it). For those who may feel that the game has too many buttons and controls, there are options for auto-aim and automatic perfectly timed bombs (which I still use). In my eyes, the only thing that matters when it comes to games is how fun they are, and this is a fun game. Edit: the extra boss is actually perfectly beatable if you learn the mechanics of the fight! Took me another four attempts and a new build, but I was able to do it.

非常有趣味的弹幕小游戏，装备搭配十分丰富，格挡、冲刺和形态切换让弹幕战也能充满操作感。 尽管有数量众多的boss和小怪，每个敌人的设计依然十分独特，战胜boss后可以用材料打造特色装备，无伤通过还能解锁皇冠标识和换装，成就感满满。 作为一个主打弹幕的游戏，玩家的判定点可以说是很大，而战斗场地也偏小。但是作为补偿，玩家有着比较优秀的性能，而且boss的攻击招式也通常十分有规律。这就让战斗偏向于观察并熟悉攻击方式，通过冲刺及时进入安全地带来躲避，而不是要经常被迫在枪林弹雨中屏住呼吸艰难推进。你可以更加专注于见招拆招的战斗乐趣，而弹幕只是攻击手段中的一种更加多彩的演绎方式，而不会是该游戏唯一的意义。 从初见被暴打，到逐渐探索出应对的方法，直到最终游刃有余成功无伤，或难或易，每一个boss都能带给我独特的成长体验和美妙的成就感。我很少遇见能让我一直全身心享受的游戏，但这个游戏当之无愧。或许在某个平行宇宙我从未接触过hololive，但如果某一天我有幸遇到了它，我应该还会给出一样的评价。

The recent HoloX update is a great showcase of what tian nya is capable of, and makes me excited for the future of an already great game.

When I first heard about this game, I was thinking "I'm familiar with Touhou and its bullet hell, how bad can this get?" Turns out, it works pretty well without too many issues. As a 2D horizontal shmup, this game brings out what makes Touhou good in the setting of Hololive. By that I mean, an elite and somewhat pon shrine maiden beats the evil spirits out of her friends and fans with really good music playing. Its like Touhou but with a protagonist that actually cares about the situation at hand. The gameplay is fairly similar to Touhou; fighting waves of enemies before running into fellow members that all somehow learned danmaku patterns to beat, burn, and humiliate you with (You know, the usual). You can use materials you pick up during runs to buy new weapons, items, and upgrades which really bring out a good sense of variety and customization to how you go about your runs. The customization goes even further with the ability to change attack styles to fit your needs and alongside an invincible dash and the ability to parry melee attacks (not all of them though), you can handle anything with enough practice and the right setup. (And thats not even mentioning the cosmetics for getting no hit runs). There's even assist options for those struggling and extra stages for those looking for a challenge. The pixel and background art is nice and crisp and the music is filled with strong remixes with similarities to the famous ZUNpets. The story is straightforward with a good amount of references all around the place. Its still in development, but it does show itself to be worth its price for the content it has now and probably later on. Even for those on the fence, this game offers a demo that transfers save data to the full game. Needless to say, this is a fairly polished game and a decent hidden gem to pick up for shump fans.

I haven't played a bullet hell game before, and I only bought this because of Miko. But I'm caught off guard by how addicting this game is. The visuals are very well made, the songs are fire and the challenging gameplay feels very fun and rewarding when you finally crown that hard boss you've struggled with for many hours. And this game is still in early access! This is an amazing game for an amazing price, definitely buy it if you're interested. Really looking forward to what tian nya is cooking up next. Mikochi wa kyou mo elite!

Could be passed off as a completed product as it currently stands, with a price point that probably undervalues it a bit honestly, but that's not my decision to make. Obviously a fan of the source material, with some skin in the bullet-hell/danmaku genre too, so this was on the radar for a while before I actually dug in and played it, and it did not disappoint. Difficulty was challenging, but by no means unfair. Soundtrack is banging, especially if you're already a fan of the artists/idols/comedians the game is based off of as it's awesome to hear re-imaginings of a lot of the original songs used. Spritework was also stellar, and was cool to see well-known artists in the community given the spotlight with the vs. portraits. Highly recommend, can't wait to see further updates to this project. :)

Really good game with a lot of content to chew through. Good art, good music, good selection of holomems (though naturally as an English speaker I hope we get some EN girls in the future). Wide range of new mechanics to learn with different bosses, fun stance switching combat. It's just a really fun, solid game.

⑧ Elite Exorcist Miko is a fast-paced action game with anime-inspired visuals and supernatural themes. Its engaging story and dynamic combat will captivate fans of action-oriented storytelling.
Elite Exorcist Miko offers a compelling blend of action and strategy. Players must utilize a combination of ranged and melee attacks to defeat possessed Hololive members with roguelike elements.
[7/10] Elite Exorcist Miko shines with its compelling progression and world-building. Unlocking new abilities feels meaningful and directly impacts your combat effectiveness and exploration options.

A delightful fusion of shrine maiden aesthetics and arcade intensity. The difficulty ramps just enough to punish mistakes without punishing creativity.
